input.summary: Insert a new Section 5.5 granting the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables, with HDI retaining its generic tools and know-how and any HDI licence in Company data limited to providing the services.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership and licensing of the Site and other work product HDI develops for us, and on HDI's rights in our Content and customer/order data. We have added our fallback position: HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for our business, and any HDI licence in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership; License. HDI shall retain ownership of its generic tools and know-how. HDI hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Site and any other deliverables and work product developed for the Company under this Agreement for its business. Any license or right of HDI in Content, user information, data or other materials belonging to, supplied by, or processed for the Company is limited to processing the same solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
